scripts.postinstall: node tools/copy-almostnode-assets.mjs && pnpm build:preview && pnpm --filter @playground/app exec nuxt prepare && pnpm --filter @playground/admin exec nuxt prepare
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n play,admin,shim,serve -c magenta,blue,yellow,gray "pnpm dev:play" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:shim" "pnpm dev:serve"
scripts.build: pnpm build:preview && pnpm build:play && pnpm build:admin
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @playground/app exec nuxt typecheck && pnpm --filter @playground/admin exec nuxt typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @playground/app exec eslint . --fix --cache && pnpm --filter @playground/admin exec eslint . --fix --cache
